specification.document: A document is: an opening fence line '---', exactly nine header lines, a closing fence line '---' terminated by LF, then the body bytes (possibly empty; the body's final-newline distinction is preserved and no H1 is inserted).
specification.frontmatterKeyOrder: Fixed; every key appears exactly once in this order.
specification.scalarEncoding: Each header line is '<key>: ' + JSON.stringify(value): a single-line, minimally escaped JSON string. Parsing requires the canonical spelling (JSON.parse of the scalar must re-serialize to the same bytes); duplicate, missing, unknown, out-of-order fields, malformed or non-canonical scalars, and any other header syntax are rejected. Every value is a non-empty string; kind is one of (plan, evidence, review) and status one of (draft, published, approved).
specification.canonicalRevisionInput: The content revision is 'sha256:' + the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical UTF-8 input: the seven revision header lines in fixed order, each '<key>: ' + JSON.stringify(value) and LF-terminated, followed by a closing '---' line, followed by the exact body bytes. updated_at and status are validated but never hashed, so approval can rewrite the displayed status without changing the content revision. The revision is never an input to its own hash.
specification.rawMarkdown: Raw-markdown documents carry no frontmatter; revision = sha256 of the exact raw bytes.
